releases.name: The Boogeyman
releases.summary: Inspired by the Argentine folklore legend of The Boogeyman, several children have disappeared from neighboring farms, and rumors point to a mysterious presence roaming the countryside at night. Explore the area, use everything at your disposal to find out where he is, and keep your son safe.

releases.name: Conquisterra Roguelie
releases.summary: A 2D roguelike about escaping a dungeon nightmare, and choosing between a comforting lie or a painful truth.

releases.name: Shelf-Employed
releases.summary: Shelf-Employed is a first-person organization game set inside a chaotic magical warehouse. Sort thousands of packages, master useful spells, and upgrade your workflow as you turn towering piles of boxes into perfectly ordered shelves.

releases.name: Labyrinth of Reverie
releases.summary: Labyrinth of Reverie is a 3D first-person psychological horror game blending hidden-object puzzles with surreal exploration. Journey into shifting dreamscapes, from natural beauty to uncanny strangeness, as reality bleeds into the dream. Tailor objectives with 3 quest log styles to guide your path.

releases.name: Dark Dice Dungeon
releases.summary: If you are keen on classic sudocu, chess, chequers or mahjong, this game will definitely appeal to you. Designed hundreds years ago this excellent logic game was inaccessible for a long time. Due to simple and user-friendly interface you will find the game easy and ABSORBING. The goal is simple - fill the magic square to get rows, columns and main diagonals having sums equal to 65. Do it by moving purple numbers from the right field to open spots on the left field while grey numbers remain static. The game trains your logic. Sudocu 65 is a real time killer for those who like to tease their brains. DIFFERENT LEVELS OF DIFFICULTY Choose the right difficulty level, improve your results and publish them in the "Game Center"HINTS If you can't find a right solution for a long time, you can always use a hint. It will guide your mind in a right direction.

releases.name: BumpBall
releases.summary: Created to accompany the book Marmalade SDK Mobile Game Development Essentials, published by Packt Publishing, this game demonstrates the use of the Marmalade SDK for displaying 3D graphics, playing sound and music, getting player inputs and much more besides.Over the course of ten chapters the book teaches video game programmers how to use their existing C++ development skills to develop iOS games.This game evolves throughout the book as new functionality provided by Marmalade is explored so readers can see how it has been built from beginning to end.

releases.name: Tchenovstok
releases.summary: Curve is a funny realtime multiplayer strategy Game. It's similar to snake. Play over WiFi or 3G with your friends or with random Players around the world.The Rules are simple: - Don't cross the Wall or the opponents line. - Try to encircle your opponents line. - Get Points to activate Superpowers.

releases.name: MoooooN - The cow jumps over the moon
releases.summary: You play as Cow, a cow who has always wanted to jump over the moon! Luckily, their friends have figured out a way it might just be possible... Jump through interesting levels and speak to a cast of silly characters as you make your way there!

releases.name: Balloon Pop 9999
releases.summary: Memory match games are the best source to enhance the time management skills in kids. So it’s time you let your kids get some serious time management skills and improve their memorizing skills.This is one of the best games for your kids as they would love to play with the super heroes. Maker and cooking games might be good for the kids in terms of management but it would be more fun matching the cards rather than dealing the angry customers.Kids love being with the super heroes. They have those attributes that inspire the kids as they wanna look like them or wanna fly and fight in angry mood as they do. Kids need to show their skills, as they need to win the race of time matching up the cards. They have to run faster than the timer and finish the matching before time to move to the next level that is more challenging and fun.Leave the guns of the crime and stop racing with the thunder moto cars. It’s time to race with time in memory match. Let’s match the super heroes that look similar. Only a frontlinesuper hero can match the hiddenheroes to secure the place. Tic-toc timer sound.So don’t wait longer when it’s about getting time management and good memory skills for your preschool kids. Let them be with the super heroes and become one of them. All the BMX loving boys and girls out of the bubble soap would love to be that little agent that can match the heroes like never before. Track the super heroes all the way through card matching to acquire time management and good memory.

releases.summary: Which will win ?  human brain or the computer, the computer speed is certainly the fastest, because it only konws zero and one. but for skills, the computer can only stand by,  because you can do anything besides zero and one.

releases.name: Knightime
releases.summary: Super fun and easy board game for up to 6 players (pirates) of all ages!The Pirate Treasure Hunt is a classic board game of chance and betting where the goal is to loot an island and fill up your pirate ship with treasure!- Roll the dice and try to get as much loot and treasure of the island as possible!- Steal from or attack other players to get the advantage!- 6 colorful characters to choose from, each with unique voice and personality!- 3 islands to visit, with different amounts of treasure!- Made for iPad! 2-6 players on the same screen! (but works on iphone as well)- Perfect replacement for a classic board game! Realistic dice rolling!- Great as a party game!This is version 1.0. The next version which will also feature:- More music tracks during gameplay!- Additional languages! (swedish, french, spanish, german)- Options for setting up a custom game!

releases.name: GRIDMINE
releases.summary: GRIDMINE is a retro tower defense built around incremental progression. Survive for as long as possible, then return to your skill tree to spend extracted resources on tower-based upgrades and abilities.

releases.name: Two Minds One Car
releases.summary: Experience a unique cooperative driving adventure where teamwork is key: one player controls the steering wheel, while the other manages the gas and brake. Success depends on perfect coordination and precise timing.

releases.name: The Anomalarian
releases.summary: The house is lying to you. Notice what changed, decide if it's safe, and live with being wrong. A first-person psychological horror game where every room hides an anomaly, your sanity is the only health bar you have, and the things in the dark are watching to see if you'll believe your own eyes.

releases.name: Taskbar Quest
releases.summary: A tiny idle RPG that lives on your desktop. Park it on your taskbar or anywhere on screen, and four heroes march through 7 acts while you work, study or play. Gear them up, shape their skills, and come back to loot and levels. Fully offline: no account, no servers, no microtransactions.

releases.name: Game Market Mayhem
releases.summary: Game Market Mayhem is a cozy organization simulator where you sort 5,120 scattered game boxes according to their genres and platforms. Transform a massive pile of boxes into the perfect game store. Fill the shelves, unwind, and enjoy the satisfaction of everything being in order!

releases.name: Shopping Center Simulator
releases.summary: Build and manage your own shopping center! Open new stores, stock shelves, set prices, hire employees, deal with thieves, keep customers happy, and grow your business. Play alone or manage your mall together with friends in online co-op.

releases.name: Hack Faster
releases.summary: Correctly answer a certain number of questions to silence this alarm.
